evidence: Built the criterion->requirement map for all 51 criteria (2 gates, 39 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual). Every criterion traces to an explicit public requirement or a professional default; none demands an exact route, label, selector, layout, element id or wording, and app_context.md:33-34, functional prompt.md:15 ('Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording') and visual prompt.md:14 forbid that. Representative traces: hro_job_open places 0/51/2.5 and non-manager HM -> rules.md:27-29 (whole number 1-50, HM from hiring-manager accounts); hro_add_email_rules case-insensitive duplicate, error at the field, typed text kept -> rules.md:32-35; hro_move_one_stage/hro_reject_hired/hro_reopen -> rules.md:47-53; hro_arrive_bottom -> rules.md:57-58; hro_interview_* -> rules.md:63-65; hro_refused_put_back focus on the card -> rules.md:84-85; hro_mgr_* -> rules.md:69-73; hro_anonymous 401 -> rules.md:21; hro_stale_refused names who -> rules.md:77-80 and instruction.md:3; hro_bulk_* board order and all-or-none -> rules.md:89-92; hro_undo_* incl. note-not-a-change, once-only, later-move supersedes, overfill -> rules.md:96-100; hro_activity newest-first/filter/reason -> rules.md:110-113; hro_live_board/hro_msg_exchange/hro_unread_counts 15 s without reload -> rules.md:117-119 and instruction.md:5; hro_msg_compose -> rules.md:138-140; hro_thread_latest/hro_thread_earlier/hro_pol_earlier_place -> rules.md:144-147; hro_unread_* -> rules.md:151-160; hro_seen incl. Observer never counts -> rules.md:164-166; hro_drafts/hro_pol_session_resume incl. other user sees none -> rules.md:170-175 and instruction.md:7; note-draft legs in hro_pol_failed_send/hro_pol_session_resume -> rules.md:105-106; hro_pol_live_board -> rules.md:121-123 and instruction.md:5; hro_candidate_* wording/privacy/404 -> rules.md:23 and 179-193; hro_restart -> instruction.md:15. Seed-derived figure 'Lena starts with 1 unread' (functional prompt.md:25, hro_unread_counts) re-derived: APP-301 has 3 messages, reads USR-CAN3 read_count 2, third message by USR-REC3 -> 1. Sign-in/sign-out use is house convention per workbook E28 and SKILL known false positives. Optional behaviours are explicitly not graded: dragging (hro_move_one_stage), hiding refused controls (several rows), Observer control visibility 'app's choice' (hro_observer_readonly), notes not required in Activity, refusal text on wrong password (render gate). Visual likert rows are craft judgements with layout/labels declared the implementer's choice and phone/theme excluded, matching instruction.md:11. Minor wording edges that could false-fail a conforming app (none rises to a demonstrated defect): (1) hro_candidate_private requires the replayed staff card-detail or notes read to be 'refused', while board/Activity reads may be 'answered with only that candidate's own data'; an app with a shared role-filtered GET for an application could answer Tomas's own card with a sanitized 200. Supported by rules.md:193 ('The board ... and every staff action are refused to candidates') and card details being a board feature (rules.md:104), but the asymmetry is unexplained; golden refuses (index.js:376 auth(...STAFF)). (2) hro_activity 'naming who and the stages' applied to re-ordering lines; rules.md:110-111 asks only 'who did it and what changed'. A reorder line 'Rafael Costa moved Y up two places' could be read as lacking stages; golden writes 'reordered X in <Stage>' (index.js:267). (3) Functional prompt.md:45 protocol R says 'confirm no move, add or note control is offered' to Observer/candidate, while hro_observer_readonly and prompt.md:23 say offering is the app's choice; criterion text governs, but the protocol wording could bias the judge. (4) hro_pol_live_board requires the move to be 'visible on this page' with card details open; a full-page or aria-modal card view could hide the board update and trigger the 'no update arrives ... row is 0' clause, though instruction.md:5 implies the card is open on the board. (5) hro_job_open 'appears with those values' and hro_reject_reason 'rejected-from stage available to staff' assume display of team/HM/places and the rejected-from stage; professional defaults, low risk. Runtime: no full configured judge run of the golden exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'), so absence of false-fails on the golden or a conforming alternative is unmeasured; this missing evidence keeps risk=true.
counterexample: Conforming alternative, not a demonstrated failure: an app whose candidate view and staff card details share one role-filtered GET for an application; replayed as Tomas on his own application it returns 200 with title/team/status only (no notes, reason, rejected-from stage or position). It satisfies the data exclusion in rules.md:191-192, yet hro_candidate_private's 'staff notes or card-detail read is refused' could score it 0 if the judge replays Tomas's own card. Likewise an Activity reorder line 'Rafael Costa moved Y up two places' could be failed by hro_activity's 'naming ... the stages'.
suggested_fix: Optional wording tightening: in hro_candidate_private accept 'refused, or answered with only that candidate's own non-staff data' for the card-detail/notes read (matching the board/Activity leniency) or specify a non-own card for the replay; in hro_activity say 'naming who and what changed (the stages for moves)'; drop 'confirm no move, add or note control is offered' from protocol R; then obtain a full configured judge run on the golden to measure absence of false-fails.
